findings.finding: A novel unauthenticated phrase (for example, `credential refresh required`) plus the documented client-side `backend: label=` echo attests true; GATE-1 is a finite denylist and GATE-2 trusts an unauthenticated echo.
findings.fix: Do not accept `backend: label` as agy proof; require a backend-authenticated, invocation-bound served-model receipt or fail closed.

findings.finding: The shared-log filter uses only a time window and ignores the logged PID/run identity, so a concurrent agy invocation can donate the positive serve marker.
findings.fix: Require exclusive probe ownership plus a verifiable per-spawn correlation identifier, and reject uncorrelated log records.

findings.finding: Reconstructing timestamps with the post-run current year drops genuine Dec-31 records after a Jan-1 rollover and can accept a prior-year Jan-1 record at the same clock time.
findings.fix: Resolve candidate years from `startedMs`, reject rollover ambiguity fail-closed, and add year-boundary tests.

findings.finding: Dropping all untimestamped continuations can discard a wrapped terminal unauth signal or genuine serve marker; the former can combine with retained label evidence.
findings.fix: Attach a continuation only to the immediately preceding verified in-window log record and test wrapped log forms.

findings.finding: The authenticated positive is synthetic and bypasses `filterAgyLogToRunWindow`, so it does not prove a real clean authenticated log survives attribution.
findings.fix: Replay a sanitized genuine timestamped agy transcript through filter, combine, and attestation end to end.

findings.finding: The required 19-11 fixture evaluates only the 2KB `cli_output_head`, which contains neither the deceptive auth line nor backend label; restoring the old auth-suffix slice would still let this fixture test pass.
findings.fix: Commit a redacted full 19-11 transcript containing both lines, evaluate it directly, and pin its SHA-256.

findings.finding: `--provider antigravity` accepts a non-catalog display name; the pass-through mapper and agy policy permit it, allowing a non-contracted model such as `Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking)` to be attested.
findings.fix: Require a catalog model entry before mapping/spawning and make unmapped Antigravity model resolution fail.
